caption:
Cold traffic and warm traffic are not the same buy. One of them already knows who you are.

Most businesses only ever advertise to strangers. Then they wonder why the cost per customer is so high.

Meanwhile there's a list sitting in your account that you've never once targeted:

→ People who follow you
→ People who visited your profile in the last 30 days
→ The same, at 60 and 90 days
→ Anyone who liked, saved or commented on a post
→ People who watched 25%, 50% or 75% of a video
→ People who reached the last card of a carousel

That last one is the most underrated audience on the platform. Someone who swiped to the end of a 7-slide carousel read your entire argument. Voluntarily. They are not a stranger any more.

Every one of these people already raised a hand. You can build an audience from each of them and advertise to them on their own.

It costs less and it closes faster, for the obvious reason: you're not paying to introduce yourself twice.

📌 Send this to someone running ads to a cold audience only. This is the cheapest thing they'll change all month.
